summary: Most inventory plugins use a YAML config file as source with one required field, plugin, naming the plugin, plus optional fields like cache_plugin and cache_timeout.
questions: What field is required in an inventory plugin config file?
Which cache options can go in an inventory YAML config?

answer_card.title: Common inventory config format
answer_card.answer_md: The YAML config's only required field is `plugin`, the name of the plugin that should consume it. Other fields depend on features used, e.g. `cache_plugin`, `cache_timeout`, plus plugin-specific options.
